abstract: Abstract After the Second World War, family allowances became a cornerstone of social spending in western Europe. Whilst religion is often highlighted as a driver of this policy, the role of political Catholicism remains contested, particularly in southern Europe. This paper examines the Spanish case, tracing the development of family allowances from their inception in 1926 to the conclusion of early Francoist labour legislation in 1958. It connects the policy preferences of political factions and interest groups to the evolution of family allowances under three political regimes. The study argues that understanding the role of social groups, particularly Catholics, requires addressing both their social policy goals and redistributive preferences. It shows Catholic cadres’ consistent advocacy for family allowances as public support for the family wage since the 1920s, despite resistance from employers and the labour movement. Their preference for corporatism and limited redistribution shaped their framing as a social insurance and occupational scheme, implementing it even before the end of the Spanish Civil War as Catholic influence increased. However, the redistributive preferences of Catholics imposed structural limits to the scheme's expansion, particularly in agriculture, further constrained by competition with Falange and the dictatorship's resistance to tax reform.
abstract_zh: 摘要 第二次世界大战后，家庭津贴成为西欧社会支出的基石。尽管宗教常被视为这一政策的驱动力，但政治天主教主义的作用仍存争议，尤其是在南欧。本文考察西班牙案例，追溯家庭津贴自1926年创立至1958年佛朗哥早期劳动立法结束的发展历程，将政治派别与利益集团的政策偏好与三个政治体制下家庭津贴的演变联系起来。研究认为，理解社会群体（尤其是天主教徒）的作用，需同时考虑其社会政策目标与再分配偏好。研究表明，自1920年代以来，天主教干部一贯主张将家庭津贴作为对家庭工资的公共支持，尽管遭到雇主和劳工运动的抵制。他们对社团主义及有限再分配的偏好，塑造了其作为社会保险和职业计划的框架，并在天主教影响力增强时，甚至在西班牙内战结束前便予以实施。然而，天主教徒的再分配偏好对该计划的扩展施加了结构性限制，尤其在农业领域，加之与长枪党的竞争及独裁政权对税收改革的抵制，进一步制约了其发展。
title: Religious politics and the limits of redistribution: The rise and fall of family allowances in Spain, 1926–58
title_zh: 宗教政治与再分配的局限：西班牙家庭津贴的兴衰（1926–1958）

abstract: This study examines the impact of recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) on firm-level employment using an imputation-based difference-in-differences (DiD) approach across U.S. states. RMLs significantly reduce employment, particularly among firms with high-skilled labor, strong union presence, permissive corporate cultures, and in states with greater dispensary density. Alternative explanations—including economic crises, COVID-19, fiscal changes, labor regulations, and related policies such as smoking bans and right-to-work (RTW) laws—are systematically ruled out through a series of placebo and robustness tests. RMLs also reduce investment, sales growth, and innovation, suggesting that legalization introduces labor-related frictions with broad implications for firm performance and long-term dynamism.
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Employment Under Marijuana

abstract: The return of rural labour has led to a rise in the ‘localization’ of work, which in turn has triggered changes in the structure of household labour. In the context of food security, the impact of this change on food production deserves attention. Analyzes the impact of ‘localized’ and ‘non-localized’ rural labour on food production using data from the 2020 China Rural Revitalization Survey (CRRS). The results show that: (1) ‘localized’ labour is more likely to promote food production than ‘non- localized’ labour. (2) ‘localized’ and ‘non-localized’ workers can inhibit food production by increasing the time share of labour inputs. (3) ‘localized’ and ‘non-localized’ workers can promote food production by increasing the level of survival security of workers. (4) Market heterogeneity and food type heterogeneity have differentiated effects on the impact of ‘localization’ on food production. Based on this, the study suggests that we should promote the industrialization and urbanization of prefectures, maximize the non-farm income of part-time labourers and the ‘trinity’ of the local land transfer market, agricultural socialized service market, and employment market.
abstract_zh: 农村劳动力回流导致工作“本地化”程度上升，进而引发家庭劳动力结构变化。在粮食安全背景下，这一变化对粮食生产的影响值得关注。利用2020年中国乡村振兴调查（CRRS）数据，分析农村劳动力“本地化”与“非本地化”对粮食生产的影响。结果表明：（1）“本地化”劳动力比“非本地化”劳动力更可能促进粮食生产。（2）“本地化”与“非本地化”劳动力均可能通过增加劳动投入时间份额抑制粮食生产。（3）“本地化”与“非本地化”劳动力均可能通过提高劳动者生存保障水平促进粮食生产。（4）市场异质性与粮食类型异质性对“本地化”影响粮食生产具有差异化效应。据此，研究建议应推进地级市工业化与城镇化，最大化兼业劳动力非农收入与本地土地流转市场、农业社会化服务市场、就业市场的“三位一体”协同发展。

title: Impact of “localized” rural workforce on food production: based on a comprehensive analysis of three major markets
title_zh: 本地化”农村劳动力对粮食生产的影响：基于三大市场的综合分析

abstract: This paper evaluates the effect of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) programme extension for international STEM graduates on major choice in the United States. The OPT programme permits international graduates to work in the U.S. while maintaining student-visa status, and the length of time allowed to work in the U.S. was significantly extended in 2008 for STEM graduates. Despite its wide use, the effect of the OPT extension on enrolment patterns remains underexplored and the analysis in this paper adds important and novel evidence on this issue. The empirical approach is based on a difference-in-differences research design, and the data for the analysis are from administrative data on student enrolment at all public universities in the state of Ohio. Estimates indicate that the OPT extension increased the likelihood of international students’ enrolment in OPT-eligible STEM fields by 19% among undergraduate students and 45% among Master’s students. Additional analyses of the effect of OPT extension on student quality and degree completion revealed a small increase in average GPAs along with approximately a 33% increase in 5- to 7-year completion rates for Bachelor’s degrees and a 50% increase in 3- to 4-year completion rates for Master’s degrees in OPT-eligible STEM fields.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了选择性实习训练（OPT）项目对国际STEM毕业生在美国专业选择的影响。OPT项目允许国际毕业生在维持学生签证身份期间在美国工作，而2008年STEM毕业生的在美工作许可期限被显著延长。尽管该项目被广泛使用，但OPT延期对入学模式的影响仍鲜有探讨，本文的分析为此问题提供了重要且新颖的证据。实证方法基于双重差分研究设计，分析数据来自俄亥俄州所有公立大学的学生入学行政记录。估计结果显示，OPT延期使国际学生就读OPT合格STEM领域的概率在本科生中提高了19%，在硕士生中提高了45%。进一步分析OPT延期对学生质量和学位完成情况的影响发现，在OPT合格STEM领域，平均绩点略有上升，同时学士学位5至7年完成率提高了约33%，硕士学位3至4年完成率提高了50%。
title: If you extend it, they will come: the effects of the STEM OPT extension
title_zh: 若你延长，他们便会来：STEM OPT延期的影响

abstract: This study examines the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption on breakthrough innovation in Chinese listed enterprises between 2007 and 2023. The results show that the AI adoption significantly improves an enterprises’ ability to achieve breakthrough innovation. Moreover, mechanism analysis demonstrates that AI adoption promotes breakthrough innovation by increasing knowledge diversity, overcoming organizational inertia and improving resource allocation efficiency. Furthermore, absorptive capacity is crucial in bolstering AI adoption’s impact on breakthrough innovation. A heterogeneity analysis reveals that state-owned enterprises, enterprises in highly competitive industries and more market-oriented regions see a stronger empowering effect in leveraging AI for breakthrough innovation. Additionally, compared with incremental innovation, AI adoption exerts a stronger positive effect on breakthrough innovation. The findings deepen our understanding of the pathways through which AI fosters breakthrough innovation and has practical implications for enterprises seeking to leverage AI to make technological progress.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2007年至2023年间中国上市公司采用人工智能（AI）对突破性创新的影响。结果表明，AI采用显著提升了企业实现突破性创新的能力。进一步机制分析显示，AI采用通过增加知识多样性、克服组织惯性以及提高资源配置效率来促进突破性创新。此外，吸收能力在强化AI采用对突破性创新的影响中起到关键作用。异质性分析表明，国有企业、处于高竞争行业及市场化程度较高地区的企业，在利用AI实现突破性创新时展现出更强的赋能效应。同时，相较于渐进式创新，AI采用对突破性创新的正向影响更为显著。这些发现深化了我们对AI促进突破性创新路径的理解，并为寻求借助AI实现技术进步的企业提供了实践启示。

title: The adoption of artificial intelligence and enterprises’ breakthrough innovation: an analysis based on China’s patent citation network
title_zh: 人工智能应用与企业突破性创新：基于中国专利引用网络的分析
